faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about using the platform and privacy

items.q: Is the platform free to use?
items.a: Yes, the platform is 100% free for everyone. You can create your account, claim your custom link, receive messages, and ask questions at no cost. In the future, optional premium customization and advanced analytics features may be introduced.

items.q: Are messages and replies really anonymous?
items.a: Yes, we guarantee total sender anonymity with zero identity tracking, giving you and your friends complete freedom to express yourselves.

items.q: Does a sender need an account to message me?
items.a: No, anyone with your personal link can send you a secret message or reply to your questions directly without creating an account.

items.q: What is the "Honestly Forum" and how does it work?
items.a: When posting a question, you can choose to display it on the public "Honestly Forum", allowing all platform visitors to view, interact, and respond to it.

items.q: Can I send messages or reply using a nickname?
items.a: Absolutely. Senders have full flexibility to choose between complete anonymity or using a custom nickname.
